title: Exploring the capabilities of 2-alkynyl aryl/benzyl azides: synthesis approaches for indoles, quinolines, and their derivatives via transition metal catalysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1163-1204
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08280J, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Seyedmohammad Hosseininezhad, Sina Pirani Ahmad Abad, Ali Ramazani
This review covers the metal-catalyzed transformation of 2-alkynyl aryl/benzyl azides into indoles and quinolines (2011–2024), addressing substrates, recent advancements, research challenges, and mechanisms to promote further research.
